name: ElevenLabs
description: Make voices, sound effects and music with your own ElevenLabs API key and plan, not Genex credits.
setup: Create an API key at elevenlabs.io under Developers, then API Keys.
In Genex, open the plugin's Configuration, paste the key and press Connect.
Audio is paid from your ElevenLabs plan, not from Genex credits. Music needs a paid plan.
